Try it with model='deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp' . DeepSeek Harness 0.1.1 was released today with out-of-the-box support for the new model. Multimodality unlocks more agent use cases 👀 ​ V4-Flash-Vision-Exp works smoothly across agent frameworks, combining visual understanding with a wide range of tools to unlock more practical workflows. Multimodal API support 🔌 ​ 🔹 Set model='deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp' 🔹 Images are tokenized for billing: up to 384 tokens each, at V4-Flash pricing 🔹 Supports Chat Completions, Messages & Responses 🔹 Supports mixed text + image input; images can be provided via base64, external URLs, or the Files API Docs: API Guides - Vision Files API is now live 📁 ​ 🔹 Free to use 🔹 Upload an image once, then reference it by file_id to save request bandwidth 🔹 Reuse the same image across requests—no need to upload it again Learn more: API Guides - Files API Previous Delete File Next DeepSeek-V4-Pro GA Release Multimodality unlocks more agent use cases 👀 Multimodal API support 🔌 Files API is now live 📁 WeChat Official Account Community Email Discord Twitter More GitHub Copyright © 2026 DeepSeek, Inc.
